rationale: Production training uses long sequences (≥65k) + ckpt=0 + ZeRO-3. In that
regime FFN compute per layer (~15 ms) > FSDP AllGather per layer (~5 ms),
so with forward_prefetch=True the AllGather is fully hidden by compute.
The b_step_fb (per-step FSDP re-shard / re-gather penalty) calibrated at
the b-decomp short-seq (8192) experiment is therefore NOT applicable in
production — that experiment was the worst case where compute << AllGather.
Re-analysing the github multi-mb run (results/ghmb_20260526_140123) shows:
• predictions with b_step_fb get 18/21 pairs ranked correctly, MAPE 121%
• predictions WITHOUT b_step_fb (saturation):  19/21 pairs correct, MAPE 81%
• for forced strategies alone (excluding solver), saturation gives 15/15.
So we zero out b_step_fb_per_sp here. residual_a_per_sp is kept (the per-mb
compute coefficient was re-fitted with forward_prefetch=True and remains
valid). b_step_external_ms is kept (optimizer + grad_clip overhead is real).
